- Bradley became hopeful and proposed a joint strategy meeting to integrate traditional and digital marketing. He heard Katherine agree, say combining strengths could improve results, and suggest scheduling a brainstorm. He said he was hopeful about leveraging both their expertise and appreciated collaboration. He heard Katherine look forward to it and agree to make it happen.
- After the joint meeting, he was excited and worked overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He showed it to Katherine and heard her praise it as comprehensive and well thought out. He said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart from competitors and wanted to nail the presentation. He heard Katherine express confidence and suggest fine-tuning it together.
- Following the presentation and implementation of the new strategy, he felt grateful for his professional growth and their collaboration. He thanked Katherine and said he had learned much. He heard her say it was a pleasure, that the project came to fruition, and that his openness made it a successful partnership. He proposed regular strategy sessions. He heard Katherine agree, saying regular sessions would keep them on top of their game and market trends. They agreed to do it.
